title: Binary encoding of a labeled sample
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ map the sign cube of dimension $n$ to the two signs $-1$ and $1$, and let $x$ be a point of that sign cube. Encoding the sample $(x,f(x))$ as a binary input and binary label gives the pair consisting of the binary encoding of $x$ and the binary encoding of $f(x)$ evaluated at that encoded input.
